rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act (notice of tenants' rights when ending a tenancy)
rules.requirement: A landlord planning to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the notice to quit or notice of non-renewal. The landlord must also submit the tenant's contact information and a copy of the notice to the City through its online portal.
rules.requirement_es: El propietario que planee terminar un contrato de alquiler debe entregar al inquilino un Aviso de Derechos y Recursos de los Inquilinos al mismo tiempo que el aviso de desalojo o de no renovación. También debe enviar a la Ciudad, por el portal en línea, los datos de contacto del inquilino y una copia del aviso.
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all landlords (and foreclosing owners) ending a tenancy.
rules.key_value: Notice delivered together with notice to quit / non-renewal
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day (enforced by Inspectional Services). Violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.caveat: This is a notice/procedural requirement, not a just-cause limit on eviction grounds; effective date not stated on the page.
